newsitem.title: UK: GrandMet to sell Shippams brand name.
newsitem.headline: GrandMet to sell Shippams brand name.

text.p: British food and drinks giant Grand Metropolitan Plc said it was close to selling its Shippams Paste brand as part of a 150 million stg disposals programme.
A spokesman confirmed a report in the Sunday Times news apper that said Shippams -- a fish spread eaten by generations of British schoolchildren -- would be sold to a trade buyer for 20 million stg.
Businesses worth another 100 million stg will be sold over the next month, completing a 300 million stg disposal programme at Pillsbury, GrandMet's U.S. subsidiary, the paper said.
